about: Word flashcards, most common first. Order and rank from a word count of Chinese film and TV subtitles (OpenSubtitles 2018, hermitdave/FrequencyWords, CC BY-SA 4.0), traditional forms merged into simplified. Left out: names, swear words, subtitle artefacts (我要, 我会), written-only words (之, 于, 而), erhua forms the voice can't say (哪儿), and most action-film words (枪, 尸体). rank = place in that count; the order of this list is the order new words come in.

words.english: (links a describer to a noun): 's, of
words.note: 我的 = my, 好的 = good / OK.
After a verb, it's done: 我吃了 = I've eaten. At the end, something is new: 下雨了 = it's raining now.
Links two nouns: 我是学生. Not used before adjectives: 我很好, not 我是好.

words.english: at, in; to be (somewhere); (doing) right now
words.note: 我在家 = I'm at home. 我在吃 = I'm eating. Sounds the same as 再.
们 makes a plural for people.
Sounds the same as 她 (she) and 它 (it).

words.english: (turns a sentence into a yes/no question)

words.note: Becomes bú before a 4th tone: bú shì.

words.english: to have; there is / there are
words.note: The opposite is 没有, never 不有.
我马上就来 = I'm coming right away.
走吧! = Let's go! 你是学生吧? = You're a student, right?
Sounds the same as 他 (he) and 它 (it).
Often said zhèi before a measure word.
Often said zhīdao. For knowing a person: 认识.
我很好 = I'm good. Before an adjective it often just links and hardly means "very".

example.english: I'd like a glass of water.

words.note: 我会说中文 = I can speak Chinese.
Only joins nouns: 你和我. Never joins two sentences.
Often said nèi before a measure word.

words.note: 个 is the most common measure word. 一 is yí before a 4th tone (个 is gè on its own).
Also the past "not": 我没有去 = I didn't go.
把门关上 = close the door.
Sounds the same as 坐 (to sit).
不 is bú before a 4th tone.

words.note: For being able or allowed; 会 is for a learned skill.

words.note: Sounds the same as 他 (he) and 她 (she).
